title: Item upgrades
summary: Turn matching copies into a higher quality, with the right recipe for each system.
body:
Upgrade recipes

Guaranteed upgrades with no coin fee
InputResultMethod
3 identical eligible Normal/Base copies1 PolishedReforging Box; #zoneforge for zone rewards
4 identical Polished copies1 ExaltedReforging Box; #zoneforge for zone rewards
4 identical Exalted copies1 Ascended ordinary item, or 1 Ascension zone rewardReforging Box; #zoneforge for zone rewards

Get the reusable Reforging Box

  1. Hail Artisan Veyra in the East Commonlands tunnel for a free Reforging Box.
  2. Put the box in a main inventory slot. Leave combat and casting, empty your cursor, and close trade, loot, merchant and station interactions.
  3. Place three identical eligible Normal/Base copies (leave one slot empty), or four identical Polished or Exalted copies in the box. This is a container combine, not an NPC hand-in.
  4. Press Combine. A valid recipe consumes the required copies and gives one next-quality item; keep the box for later.

The box has no recipe above the top tier. Bags cannot be nested in the box. The supported-item catalog determines eligibility.

Three Normal items make Polished

The Reforging Box accepts exactly 3 identical eligible Normal (Base) items → 1 Polished item, for ordinary tiered equipment and Classic zone-hunt rewards. Put the three copies in the reusable box, leave its fourth slot empty, and press Combine. A matching Polished version must exist. The higher recipes still cost four copies. Stackable units count individually; nonstackable charged items count once each. Dungeon rewards and bags remain excluded. The recipe is available for live testing; in-game acceptance remains ongoing.

Before combining

Use unmodified items of one family and quality. An item's built-in color is allowed; a different player-applied dye color is not. Socketed, player-dyed, ornamented, customized and evolving instances are not eligible. Binding is preserved. Charged objects count as physical items, not as one copy per charge. If a result is unclear or items appear missing, stop retrying and contact the owner.

Keep other systems separate

Epic Ascension uses its own quest and materials. Ordinary tradeskills retain recipe requirements and success chances. The top-tier names do not mean those systems share recipes.

Dungeon rewards use Normal, Polished and Ascended qualities but have no conversion through these recipes. Earn their qualities through Grind or Raid completion and Raid final-boss drops.

The Vigil of the Dawn — live testing

Ember of the First Dawn uses #zoneforge: three Base copies or four Polished/Exalted copies make the next quality. Camil’s helmet receives no new socket. The miniboss and final Raid equipment do not use this augment recipe. Read the quest guide and reward catalog.

This update is in Change Log →

This update is in Change Log →

The Ashen Compact — live testing

The Ashen Compact is an installed level-50 Shadow Knight helmet campaign in a curated Kael expedition. Its paired server and client release is available for testing; full encounter, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

Cinder forging uses three identical Base copies, then four Polished or Exalted copies. The helmet and other Kael equipment do not use that augment recipe.

Paladin grips — live testing

The weapon grip toggle stores 1HS as an item customization. Switch back to 2HS before using the Reforging Box with an otherwise eligible weapon. Existing recipe, quality and augment requirements remain; new upgrade results start in 2HS. The SoulFire, Fiery Avenger and Fiery Defender quests now award Ascended weapons directly. Box recipes remain unchanged. Existing normal Fiery Defenders have a free Epic Forgemaster exchange; there is no automatic inventory conversion.

Power Source training — Not released

A candidate adds combat-XP training for supported ordinary equipment and Hunt augments. Place one eligible item in the Power Source slot and earn eligible combat XP; it advances through its existing qualities to Ascended (ordinary) or Ascension (Hunt). The item grants no equipment benefits while training. Existing held-class eligibility, any remaining race/deity restrictions, and required/recommended levels still apply.

The proposed Normal/Base-to-top target is roughly 4–8 hours, with increasingly longer steps: 80, 160 and 240 comparable-kill equivalents. Timing depends on earned XP, group shares and downtime and still needs in-game measurement. Character and AA XP are not spent, and AA allocation or the character level cap does not stop training.

The Reforging Box and #zoneforge retain their recipes. In this candidate, otherwise eligible copies with partial training can still be combined; that progress is discarded and the result starts its new tier at zero. Other customization restrictions remain. Progress is intended to follow the instance through transfers; custody and client checks remain pending. #itemxp reports progress when this feature is enabled. This method is not available on the player server yet.
